slides.title: Onsoo Botanicals in the US
Key questions

claims.claim: Should Onsoo enter the US in 2027, and by which route, to build toward $40M of US revenue by 2030 within the board's cash, payback and margin limits?
evidence: Success criteria: Cumulative US cash need of no more than $18M through 2030; US cash flow back to zero by the end of 2030; Group operating margin at or above 8% in every year; On the way to $40M of US revenue by 2030; Only one major new-market launch in 2027
Decision maker: CEO Park Ji-won and the board
Timing: Board meeting, March 2027
Out of scope: Makeup and hair care; DTC-led and mass-retail-led routes (not modeled); Markets other than the US and Japan; Price changes

slides.title: 2d: Payback by 2030 holds only if ad cost stays below 28.6% of sales, about the pilot's level

slides.title: 2d: The plan's 25% ad cost sits below the whole benchmark range, where scaling brands pay a median 32%

$4.7M less cumulative cash by 2030 at 32% ad cost than at 25%; enough to turn the 2030 payback into a shortfall
evidence: $0.24 a unit for each percentage point, on every planned unit

claims.claim: Plan for 28% and treat anything above it as a signal to slow the ad-funded ramp

normalized.recommendation: Launch on Amazon in 2027 under four gates; add retail only above 20% awareness. Keep ad cost at or below 28%, and lower that ceiling if the duty rises. alternatives_considered.treatment: Chosen: "Recommend, with ad cost held at or below 28%"; the only route inside the board's limits; cash low point −$1.9M, 2030 revenue $26.4M; pays back at blended ad cost up to 28.6%.

Rejected: "Reject: breaks the cap, the payback and the margin floor"; −$20.8M cumulative cash at end-2030, group margin 4.5% in 2027; inputs optimistic (4.5 units/door/week vs 2.6 at Onsoo's awareness; 1.3x halo from a 0.71 correlation); corrected need about $26M.
Deferred: "Keep for 2028: more cash to 2030, but small and outside the US"; $1.8M cumulative cash by 2030 but only $7M added revenue in a market growing about 1.5% a year.

assumptions_and_uncertainties: Synthetic benchmark data: the company and every figure are fictional
Payback by 2030 holds only if blended ad cost stays at or below 28.6%; the plan's 25% sits below the whole 26%–38% benchmark range, scaling brands pay a median 32%
The planning team applies the hero product's per-unit economics to all SKUs, which is unproven
The 2027 step-up of 1.8x the pilot's June pace is plausible, but not yet proven
Whether repeat rises once seven SKUs are listed is untested; the plan needs repeat to hold as SKUs are added
A full year of 2027 sales needs the cross-border listings kept live until Onsoo's own listings take over
US import duty decision expected in mid-2027; at 25% duty, break-even ad cost falls to 26.9%; a weaker won would offset part of a rise
At 80% of plan volume, end-2030 cash is only $0.1M even at 25% ad cost
Option B's 1.3x Amazon halo rests on a 0.71 correlation that may run the other way; the memo may miss removed brands such as Mooncrest
Four brands show a pattern, not proof: one of three Amazon-first entrants reached scale, so Option A still has to earn its volume
Model leaves out taxes, exchange-rate moves and anything after 2030
Group excluding the US held at its 11.0% plan margin; inventory of four months of landed cost
